title: Staging certificate before it expires
transcript:
[00:00] Aiko: Two things from the infra board. First, the staging certificate expires on the 12th.
[00:06] Bruno: The wildcard one? That's still manual because of the old DNS provider.
[00:12] Aiko: Yes. Last time it lapsed, every preview build failed for half a day.
[00:18] Bruno: Right, I remember. The renewal itself is ten minutes, it's the DNS record that's annoying.
[00:25] Aiko: So the cert needs renewing before the 12th, and we should move it to automatic renewal after this.
[00:33] Bruno: Agreed. I'll ping you when the DNS access is sorted.
[00:38] Aiko: Great. Second thing, the log retention change.
[00:42] Bruno: Thirty days for application logs, ninety for audit logs. I merged that yesterday.
[00:48] Aiko: Lovely. Then I'll update the data retention page to match.
[00:53] Bruno: Thanks. That's all from me.
[00:57] Aiko: Same. Talk tomorrow.
